message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts. The case: a bank employee (credit union) used false identities to obtain loans totaling 1,970,390 yuan, causing major loss. This is typical of "信用卡诈骗" or "贷款诈骗" or "非法获取贷款" which falls under "诈骗罪" (fraud) especially "贷款诈骗" (fraudulent loan). Also could be "职务侵占" (embezzlement by a staff) or "挪用资金". But the description: using false identity to obtain loans from the credit union. That's fraud. In Chinese criminal law, "贷款诈骗罪" is under article 196 (诈骗罪) with large amount. Also "职务侵占罪" applies when a staff misappropriates property of the unit. However here they used false identities to get loans from the same institution they work at. That's abusing position to commit fraud. The typical charge: "诈骗罪" (specifically "贷款诈骗罪") and possibly "职务侵占罪". In examples, they used "信用卡诈骗" for credit card fraud. For loan fraud, they might label as "诈骗". The examples show multiple crimes sometimes: e.g., "受贿;滥用职权". Here we have "诈骗". Also maybe "非法占有" but that's part of fraud.

Thus answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" not relevant. "非法获取公民个人信息" not. So just "诈骗". Possibly "职务侵占". But the facts: he is a bank employee, uses his position to issue loans with false identities. That is "职务侵占" (embezzlement of funds of the unit). However typical Chinese law: "职务侵占罪" is when a staff misappropriates property of the unit for personal use. Here he obtains loans for himself? The text doesn't say he used the loan for personal benefit, but likely he got the money. So could be both. In many cases, prosecutors charge "诈骗罪" for fraudulent loans. So answer: 诈骗.
